current_milestone: M1 — Foundation, Trace Contract & Data Layer
notes: AgentScape — 3D spatial trace visualizer for multi-agent AI runs. PRD idea 178 (row 158 in project_prds); PRD.md in the repo root is the source of truth. SEEDED 2026-10-01: init commit carries the Vite+TS+React 19+R3F CONFIG set and an app shell with NO three.js import — landing the R3F viewport is M1-T1, so do not treat the scaffold as M1-T1 done. ARCHITECTURAL RULE (PRD §5, load-bearing): the data layer (trace parser, force-directed layout, visual-attribute mapping, timeline model) is PURE and fully vitest-gated in jsdom; the render layer is a thin consumer. Rendering cannot be verified headlessly — do not try to gate visuals in tests; gate the pure half hard. INGESTION v1 IS EXACTLY ONE FORMAT: an agent_messages export (Supabase agent_messages rows). OpenTelemetry GenAI and LangGraph adapters are explicitly post-MVP (M6-T5 triage) — do not add a second parser before M6. HUMAN-HELD TASK: M5-T5 (visual review loop — walk the scene, judge the look, list defects) cannot be done by a headless agent. The build cron SKIPS M5-T5, leaves it unchecked and records no verdict, and carries on — it blocks nothing (M6-T3 defect pass consumes its findings when an interactive session has run it). Same precedent as torchship M0-T1/T3/T4. THE PRODUCT BET IS A GATE, NOT A VIBE: PRD §7 requires M5-T4 to demonstrate, against a timeline, that the spatial view surfaces at least two structural facts faster (candidate facts: per-agent fan-out, an unbounded/looping sub-agent, message-volume imbalance, cost concentration). If that cannot be demonstrated the project is a demo, not a tool, and must be reported as such — do not quietly mark M5-T4 complete. DOGFOOD: M5-T3 renders the authoring box's own debian2_bot fleet run from an agent_messages export. DON'T DRIFT: AgentReplay/traceview/tracediff already cover linear replay/search/diff — the spatial view IS the product. Gate for every task: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build (never npm run dev in cron — it never exits). Commit split: feat: <task-id> — <desc> then a separate chore: <task-id> — tracker update; never git add -A first.
